findings.message: PS1 (IRM-20-5): V(AC/L-AC/N) 374 vs rating 431 (87%) (mains_in/L_PSU to N) — above 80% derating
K1 (G5RL-1A-E-TV8 DC5): current on L_IN through pin 13 (set i_through= if the part carries less) 15 vs rating 16 (94%) — above 80% derating
findings.waived_by: designer: Relay contacts at 15 A vs 16 A (94 %): UL E41643 lists 16 A general use at 40 C (50k ops) and VDE lists 16 A at 85 C (15k ops). 15 A is the branch-breaker ceiling, not a continuous load; continuous loads are limited to 12 A = 75 % (REQ-5, calc relay_contact_continuous_ratio). Verified by T-OL and T-HEAT.

external net L_IN declares threat 'surge' but has no tvs/mov on it
findings.waived_by: designer: No MOV/TVS on mains by design (DESIGN.md C-11): insulation is coordinated for OVC III (2.5 kV transient; relay 10 kV impulse coil-contact, PCB 8 mm reinforced, 6.4 mm functional); PS1 is tested to EN 61000-4-5 level 4 (2 kV L-N) without external parts. An MOV ages and is a fire source in a closed box; a listed Type 2 SPD at the panel is recommended (Q-12). Verified by T-SURGE.

findings.message: external net L_SW1 declares threat 'overcurrent' but has no fuse/ptc on it
findings.waived_by: designer: The upstream 15 A branch breaker (REQ-2) is the single overcurrent device for the outlet paths; every element on these nets is rated >= 15 A at temperature (terminals 31 A, relays 16 A, copper 7.5 mm x 2 layers x 2 oz with 1.4x I2t margin at 2 kA; calcs mains_*). F1 protects only the PS1 branch.

findings.message: H10: mitigated only procedurally (label: outlets are not a disconnecting means; unplug the load or lock out the breaker)
findings.waived_by: designer: Outlets are not a disconnecting means; unplugging the load or locking out the breaker is the only correct mitigation.

findings.message: H15: mitigated only procedurally (the motor's own overload protection (NEC 430); 1/2 hp relay rating; contactor for larger motors)
findings.waived_by: designer: Motor overload protection belongs to the load (NEC 430), outside this board; REQ-5 limits motors to 1/2 hp.

findings.message: Q-1 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Certification path: who evaluates (AHJ field evaluation) and who installs (licensed electrician) this unlisted assembly? If neither is acceptable, buy listed products.

Q-6 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Branch protection: 15 A dual-function AFCI/GFCI breaker? (GFCI is required in kitchens, baths, garages, basements, laundry, outdoors; AFCI in most dwelling rooms.) A 20 A circuit must be re-breakered at 15 A.

Q-7 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Load list: any heaters, pumps, compressors or life-safety loads that are unsafe if a contact welds? Motors cycled more than about 5 times a day should drive a contactor.

Q-8 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Accept a two-box assembly: E1 (10 x 8 x 6 in polycarbonate, electronics) next to E2 (3-gang PVC device box, receptacles), joined by three short 14/3 NM-B cables? No listed nonmetallic box was found that takes duplex receptacles and the electronics together.
